akitaDAO.descr: the app ID of the Akita DAO

version.descr: the current version of the contract

contract.name: GuildFactory
contract.desc: Creates only Guild kernels; policy programs are owned by the separate consensus factory.

methods.name: updateGuild
methods.desc: Push the registered kernel onto a draft Guild; only that Guild's creator may trigger it.

methods.name: newGuild
methods.desc:
Both factories participate in one atomic deployment; no returned pair is left unbound.

Like the Akita DAO, every Guild creates its treasury wallet through the DAO's wallet factory,
so the creator cannot substitute a factory or wallet of their own.

methods.name: loadProgram
methods.desc: Load only the exact chunk authorized by the preceding initProgram transaction.
